GRASP_OBJECT.description: Grasp an object at a named grasp region and lift it clear.
GRASP_OBJECT.instruction: Grasp the blender lid securely at its handle and lift it clear.
GRASP_OBJECT.contract: held AND lifted>=0.05m AND stable_for(20) AND no_disallowed_contact

MOVE_OBJECT.description: Move a held object to a named destination region.
MOVE_OBJECT.instruction: Move the held blender lid to the pre-place region above the blender while maintaining a stable grasp and avoiding disallowed contact.
MOVE_OBJECT.contract: held AND at_target(xy<=0.06m,z 0.015-0.25m) AND stable_for(3) AND no_disallowed_contact

PLACE_OBJECT.description: Place a held object on a support, release, and retreat.
PLACE_OBJECT.instruction: Place the blender lid on the blender, release it after it is stably supported, then move the gripper clear.
PLACE_OBJECT.contract: supported_by AND released AND upright_error<=7deg AND gripper_clear>=0.15m

instructions: Close the lid blender by securely placing the lid on top.

Close the blender by putting its lid securely in place.
Put the lid securely on the blender so that it is closed.
